messages.author: 3c04c342136fe2e7
messages.subject: Final-ish Blog posts?
parts:
Hi all,

I was wondering if I could get our four successful students to write up a
(short !!) note for the blog about the GSoC experience: what worked, what
didn't, what you liked, what you hated -- any form or topic works.

It is useful to mark some of those thoughts now and it should help us and
others for 2011 and beyond. Can I count on you to do something -- anything,
really -- say between now and Sunday? I am sure we can count on blogmaster
Tal to hep with "production" issues.

Blog posts by mentors or casual observers would also be an options -- whoever
wants to should be welcome.

Cheers, Dirk

--
Dirk Eddelbuettel | e...@debian.org | http://dirk.eddelbuettel.com
